otherComponents.definition: Simple cycles in the exact physical board-and-turn graph; no repeated White or Black-to-move board except closure. Deduplicate rotations by full moves and all D4 symmetries. Central/corner cycle statistics use post-White positions.

positionsOnLongerCycles.method: Simple five-edge prefix plus return reachability avoiding its internal vertices; exact membership on simple cycles of at least six plies.
